restoration.taint_limit: The out-of-tree module taint did not revert after unload. Full kernel state is not claimed reversible.

observed_script_defect.detail: The MTD discovery glob mtd* also visited mtdNro symlinks and emitted nonfatal missing-name diagnostics. The selected numeric adt MTD still passed the exact 507904-byte read and post-unload baseline checks.
observed_script_defect.future_fix: Use /sys/class/mtd/mtd[0-9]* in any reuse; do not suppress discovery errors.
